brief: Synthetic checkout service: elevated errors follow a bad deployment. Inspection, write isolation, rollback, smoke verification and traffic restoration are separate actions. No real system is connected. Each attempted action consumes simulated time; the team has 10 minutes and one rollback token.

cards.INSPECT: Inspect the error dashboard and deployment metadata. Observation only; it does not change traffic or fix the service.
cards.ISOLATE: Isolate incoming writes by enabling synthetic maintenance mode before attempting a rollback.
cards.RESTORE: Restore synthetic traffic only after the smoke tests have passed.
cards.ROLLBACK: Roll back the synthetic application to the previous known-good version after inspection and isolation.
cards.VERIFY: Run synthetic smoke tests after rollback and verify the previous version works. This does not restore traffic.
